metadata./Subject: Mia cannot make a kite that flies until she teams up with Biscuit, a shy newcomer full of clever ideas, in time for the Kite Festival.

pages.text: In a hilly little village where the wind loved to play, the spring wind was strong and cheerful, and Mia loved it more than anyone. Every spring, the whole village gathered on Breezy Hill to fly kites of every shape and color.
